messages.subject: Using Shiny for Studies
parts:
Dear Shiny-Group,

Shiny seems to be ideally suited to conduct studies about the usage of statistical data through lay-persons - especially because the ProVersion provides the feature of user authentication. 
My question: I want to analyse the complete usage of the shiny apps (logging every click ...). Is there a easy way to extend the standard log at shinyapps.io that it records things like that?

Thanks in anticipation!
Samuel

Hi Samuel,
The logs we give you access to includes any output from the R process. So you add print statements in your code, it should show up in the application logs. Hope this helps.
